India's CAFE-III norms to influence 2027 car choices

India's upcoming CAFE-III norms are set to influence consumer choices for petrol, hybrid, and electric vehicles by 2027. Auto industry veterans have stated that these norms will create pathways for the industry to offer a variety of options to consumers.
